blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present an inference-time approach that enhances the visual diversity of image sets generated by text-to-image models, without compromising the average image quality. Our method leverages the intrinsic geometry of hidden representations in pretrained models to diversify images generated from the same prompt. First, we introduce a token repulsion mechanism that increases the angle between feature tokens across samples. It takes a negative Riemannian gradient step on a von Mises-Fisher mixture distribution of tokens on the unit hypersphere. Second, to preserve the quality of each output image, we propose a token density preservation mechanism that projects the repulsion-induced prediction change onto a half-space aligned with the model's score direction. This encourages the updates to remain within the high-density regions learned by the generative model. We further extend this mechanism to the output of each intermediate layer, enabling finer-grained iterative guidance. We evaluate our method on three types of pretrained text-to-image models. Experiments show substantial gains in visual diversity under identical prompts, while maintaining a comparable level of image fidelity.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个推论-时间方法,在不损害平均图像质量的前提下,增强由文本到图像模型生成的图像集的视觉多样性. 我们的方法利用了预先训练过的模型中隐藏的表达的内在几何学,使从同一提示产生的图像多样化. 首先,我们引入了一种符号反推机制,它增加了特征符号之间跨样本的角度. 它在单位超相圈上对一个冯·米塞斯-费舍(英语:Von Misses-Fisher)的代币混合分布进行负的里曼梯度步骤. 其次,为了保持每个输出图像的质量,我们提出了一个象征性的密度保存机制,将反推引发的预测变化投射到与模型的分数方向一致的半个空间上. 这鼓励将更新保留在基因模型所学的高密度区域。 我们进一步将这一机制扩大到每个中间层的输出,从而能够提供更精细的迭接指导。 我们评价我们的方法 三种类型的 预先训练的文本到图像模型。 实验显示,在相同的提示下,视觉多样性有了很大进步,同时保持了相当水平的图像忠实。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent advances in text-to-image (T2I) generation have led to unprecedented levels of visual quality [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] .
However, a challenge persists in the inherent trade-off between image quality and sample diversity [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] .
Diversity, defined as a T2I model’s ability to generate varied outputs for a fixed condition, is a critical component of generative modeling.
Enhancing diversity can foster creativity and provide designers with a broader range of visual choices [ 11 , 12 ] ,
support data augmentation [ 13 ] and test-time scaling [ 14 , 15 ] , and increase the representation of ethnicities and genders underrepresented in the data [ 16 ] .
Although diffusion and flow-matching models are capable of broad mode coverage,
they may suffer from “mode gravity” during inference [ 17 ] .
In these scenarios, models tend to generate highly similar outputs regardless of the random initial noise,
focusing on a narrow subset of the data distribution to generate only the highest confidence samples.
blocks.zh:
文本到图像(T2I)生成的近期进步导致视觉质量达到前所未有的水平[1,2,3,4,5,6].
然而,在图像质量与样本多样性之间的内在权衡方面仍然存在挑战[7、8、9、10、11]。
多样性的定义是T2I模型在固定条件下产生不同产出的能力,是基因模型的关键组成部分。
增强多样性可促进创造力并为设计者提供更广泛的视觉选择[11、12],
支持数据增加[13]和测试时间扩大[14、15],增加族裔和性别在数据中代表性不足的比例[16]。
虽然传播和流量匹配模型能够广泛覆盖模式,
在推论中,它们可能遭受“模式重力”之苦[17]。
在这些假想中,无论随机的初始噪声,模型都倾向于产生高度相似的输出,
专注于数据分布的狭义子集,只生成最高的置信度样本.

blocks.en:
Existing inference-time methods diversify samples by changing prompts or text conditioning [ 18 , 11 ] ,
optimizing initial noise [ 19 , 20 ] , or repelling image latents [ 21 , 22 ] .
More recent methods intervene in intermediate features, which carry richer information about the generated content [ 23 , 24 ] .
However, they treat each feature representation as a whole rather than explicitly modeling interactions between individual tokens.
Token-level repulsion can act more selectively, pushing highly similar cross-image tokens apart while leaving unrelated tokens untouched.
For example, a token representing a dog’s paw should be repelled from a similar paw token in another image, but not from a sky token.
NegToMe [ 25 ] follows this token-level approach, but its linear extrapolation has undesirable mathematical properties, limiting its effectiveness.
It also lacks an explicit fidelity-preserving mechanism, which can introduce artifacts.
blocks.zh:
现有的推论时间方法通过改变提示或文字条件使样本多样化[18、11],
优化初始噪声[19,20],或击退图像潜伏[21,22].
较新的方法干预中间特征,中间特征包含关于生成内容的更丰富信息[23,24].
然而,它们将每个特征作为整体对待,而不是明确地模拟单个标志之间的相互作用。
托肯级的反感可以更有选择性地行动,将高度相似的跨像符号推开,同时不动无关的符号.
例如,代表狗爪的标志应该从另一个图像中的类似标志上击退,而不是从天空标志上击退。
NegToMe [25] 遵循这个符号级方法,但其线性推导具有不可取的数学特性,限制了其有效性.
它还缺乏明确的忠诚保留机制,可以引进文物。

blocks.en:
To address this problem, we present TokenRepel, a training-free algorithm for generating diverse image sets while preserving fidelity.
To model cross-image token interactions, we represent the normalized tokens from other images as a von Mises–Fisher (vMF) mixture on the unit hypersphere.
We then update each token with a negative Riemannian gradient step on this density, increasing the angular separation between similar tokens.
To prevent these updates from degrading fidelity, we introduce a token density preservation mechanism.
It projects the repulsion-induced prediction change onto a half-space aligned with the model’s score direction,
encouraging tokens to stay in high-density regions.
We further extend this mechanism to intermediate layers, allowing for more frequent and fine-grained corrections.
Together, token repulsion and token density preservation increase the diversity of generated images while largely maintaining their fidelity.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这个问题,我们提出了TokenRepel,这是一个在保持忠诚的同时生成多种图像集的无训练算法。
为了模拟跨图像符号的相互作用,我们代表了来自其他图像的常态符号,作为单位超电圈上的 von Misses - Fisher (vMF) 混合物.
然后我们用这个密度上一个负的里曼梯度步骤来更新每个符号,增加类似符号之间的角离子.
为了防止这些更新降低忠诚度,我们采用了象征性的密度保存机制。
它将反推引发的预测变化投射到与模型的分数方向一致的半空间上,
鼓励在高密度地区留下纪念物。
我们进一步将这一机制扩大到中间层,允许更频繁和精细的更正。
信物厌恶和信物密度保护共同增加了生成图像的多样性,同时在很大程度上保持其忠诚。

blocks.en:
Our method applies to different architectures without requiring external models or additional training.
We evaluate our approach on three representative T2I models: FLUX.1-dev [ 1 ] (flow-matching), SDXL [ 4 ] (diffusion), and FLUX.2-Klein [ 26 ] (few-step distilled flow-matching).
We achieve a more favorable diversity–quality trade-off than existing inference-time methods.
Our approach is simple and effective, with moderate computational overhead.
blocks.zh:
我们的方法适用于不同的建筑,不需要外部模型或额外的训练.
我们用三种有代表性的T2I模型来评价我们的方法:FLUX.1-dev [1](流量匹配),SDXL [4](分散),和FLUX.2-Klein [26](分步蒸馏流量匹配)。
比起现有的推论时间方法,我们实现了更有利的多样性 — — 质量权衡。
我们的方法简单而有效,有适度的计算间接费用。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Although diffusion and flow-matching models improve both diversity and fidelity over GANs [ 27 , 28 , 29 ] ,
further enhancing the sampling diversity remains a critical challenge [ 17 ] .
This issue is further compounded by recent trends in model optimization,
as both post-training [ 9 , 8 , 30 ] and distillation [ 31 ] have been shown to diminish diversity.
To mitigate this, Datta et al. [18] use specialized LLMs to generate diverse descriptions. Harrington et al. [19] repeatedly generate image batches and update their initial noise using diversity and quality objectives.
GASS decomposes image embeddings into orthogonal axes for independent prompt-dependent and prompt-independent variation [ 10 ] .
Group Inference generates a large candidate pool and selects a subset by jointly considering image quality and group diversity [ 32 ] .
These approaches may require external models, additional decoding, or a much larger candidate pool.
blocks.zh:
虽然传播和流动匹配模式提高了全球网络的多样性和忠诚性[27、28、29],
进一步加强抽样多样性仍然是一项关键的挑战[17]。
这一问题因模型优化的近期趋势而进一步加剧。
由于培训后[9、8、30]和蒸馏[31]都表明减少了多样性。
为缓解这种情况,Datta等人。 [18] 使用专门的LLMs来生成不同的描述. 哈灵顿等人. [19] 反复生成图像批次,并利用多样性和质量目标更新其初始噪声.
GASS将图像分解成嵌入正弦轴,用于独立的即时依赖和即时独立的变异[10].
组推论通过联合考虑图像质量和组多样性生成一个大候选集合并选择一个子集[32].
这些办法可能需要外部模式、额外的解码或更大的候选人人才库。

blocks.en:
Other inference-time interventions have also been proposed. Um and Ye [16] introduced guidance that moves samples beyond high-density regions.
Contrastive Noise Optimization (CNO) optimizes batches of initial noise latents with a contrastive loss on their Tweedie estimates [ 33 ] .
CADS perturbs text embeddings early in sampling according to a schedule [ 11 ] .
SPARKE and Particle Guidance (PG) optimize batch latents with dissimilarity objectives based on inverse Rényi kernel entropy and pairwise RBF kernels, respectively [ 21 , 22 ] .
Shielded Diffusion applies sparse repulsion to nearby Tweedie estimates [ 34 ] ;
DSM disperses intermediate features through feature self-guidance [ 23 ] ;
and Contextual Repulsion repels contextual embeddings in multimodal attention [ 24 ] .
These methods generally do not model fine-grained interactions between image feature tokens or explicitly correct diversity-promoting updates to preserve fidelity.
NegToMe linearly extrapolates attention tokens away from a reference image within the batch [ 25 ] , but this update can push less similar tokens farther apart.
Motion Modes [ 35 ] also uses repulsion to enhance diversity in video generation.
It guides each new object motion away from previously generated motion fields.
TokenRepel instead repels similar hidden tokens across images using angular feature geometry, then corrects the induced predictions toward a high-density half-space to preserve fidelity.
blocks.zh:
还提出了其他推断时间干预措施。 Um and Ye [16]引入了将样本移到高密度区域以外的指导.
对比噪声优化(CNO)优化了一批初始噪声潜伏,其Tweedie估计值出现对比性损失[33].
CADS 扰动文本在采样中及早嵌入,按照附表[11].
SPARKE和颗粒指导(PG)在逆Rényi内核内核和对偶RBF内核的基础上,优化了批量潜伏,具有异质目标[21,22].
屏蔽扩散对附近的Tweedie估计值进行微小的反感[34];
DSM通过特征自导[23]分散中间特征;
和上下文的推回可以消除多式联运注意力中的环境内涵[24]。
这些方法一般不建模图像特征符号之间精细的相互作用,也不明确校正促进多样性的更新以维护忠诚.
NegToMe线性推导注意符号远离批量 [25] 中的参考图像,但这一更新可以将不太相似的符号推得更远.
Motion Modes [35] 也使用反感增强视频生成的多样性.
它引导每个新的物体运动远离以前产生的运动场.
TokenRepel用角特征几何来击退图像之间的类似隐藏符号,然后将诱导的预测更正为高密度半空间,以保持忠诚。

blocks.en: 3 Enhancing Image Diversity
blocks.zh: 3 加强图像多样性

blocks.en:
In this section, we present our algorithm for enhancing image diversity, as depicted in Figure 2(a) .
Given a set of image token features, our goal is to have similar features repel each other.
This can be visualized as an electron cloud (feature set) in which electrons (features) repel one another when too close but are otherwise unaffected.
Like electrons around a nucleus, the features cannot move arbitrarily; they remain on spherical shells.
This reflects the notion that the angle between two feature vectors captures their semantic similarity more faithfully than Euclidean distance [ 36 , 25 , 37 ] ;
thus, repulsion should change their angle rather than their magnitudes.
The PyTorch-style pseudocode is provided in Algorithm 1 .
blocks.zh:
如图2(a)所示,我们在本节介绍了增强图像多样性的算法。
鉴于一组图像符号特征,我们的目标是有类似的特征互相击退.
这可视化为电子云(feature set),其中电子(features)在太近时互相击退,但否则不会受到影响.
与核周围的电子一样,特征不能任意移动;它们留在球壳上.
这反映了一种观点,即两个特征矢量之间的角度比欧几利得距离[36,25,37]更忠实地捕捉其语义相似性;
因此,反感应改变其角度而不是幅度。
PyTorch风格的伪码在算法1中提供.

blocks.en: 4 Preserving Image Fidelity
blocks.zh: 4 保存图像清晰度

blocks.en:
An unconstrained token repulsion can improve diversity but may move predictions away from the model’s learned distribution,
reducing image quality and prompt adherence.
To preserve fidelity, we introduce a token density preservation mechanism that prevents repulsion-induced updates from pointing away from high-density regions of latent space.
The pretrained flow-matching model implicitly encodes a direction toward these regions [ 38 , 39 , 40 ] ,
which we infer from its model predictions and use to restrict the token movement.
The PyTorch-style pseudocode is provided in Algorithm 2 .
blocks.zh:
不受限制的符号反射可以改善多样性,但可以使预测远离模型的已知分布,
降低图像质量并迅速遵守。
为了保持忠诚,我们引入了一种象征性的密度保存机制,防止推倒引起的更新从潜在空间的高密度区域引出。
预先训练的流量匹配模型隐含地编码了朝这些地区的方向[38、39、40],
我们从模型预测中推断出 用来限制符号运动
PyTorch风格的伪码在算法2 中提供.

blocks.en:
We compare TokenRepel with training-free methods for enhancing image diversity, including
CADS [ 11 ] , SPARKE [ 21 ] , Particle Guidance (PG) [ 22 ] , NegToMe [ 25 ] , Contextual Repulsion [ 24 ] , Group Inference [ 32 ] , Shielded Diffusion [ 34 ] , and Contrastive Noise Optimization (CNO) [ 33 ] .
Each method has a hyperparameter that controls the diversity–quality trade-off.
We sweep this parameter on GenEval for FLUX.1-dev, FLUX.2-Klein-9B, and SDXL.

The swept values and fixed settings of each method are listed in Section C.1 .
TokenRepel gives the best trade-off on FLUX.2-Klein-9B and the second-best trade-off on FLUX.1-dev and SDXL.
Its performance is also the most stable across the three models.

while keeping HPSv3 within a model-specific range,
which reflects the variation of baseline HPSv3 across random seeds. Table 1 reports the full evaluation metrics at the selected settings and their latency.

blocks.en:
We evaluate TokenRepel with batch sizes from 2 to 12 using FLUX.2-Klein-9B and matched seeds.
As shown in Figure 9 , the HPSv3 gap to the baseline remains relatively stable as batch size increases,
DreamSim decreases slightly, and Vendi Score rises with the size of the generated set.
Because DreamSim is a pairwise metric, larger batches include more image pairs,
increasing the likelihood that some pairs converge to similar modes after a one-step repulsion.
In contrast, the Vendi Score increases with batch size because it estimates the effective number of distinct samples in the evaluated set.
This difference is therefore statistical and does not indicate that either larger or smaller batches produce a more diverse distribution.
blocks.zh:
我们使用FLUX.2-Klein-9B并配对种子来评估TokenRepel的批量尺寸从2到12。
如图9所示,随着批量规模的增加,与基准的HPSv3差距仍然相对稳定,
DreamSim略有减少,Vendi Score随着生成集的大小而上升.
因为DreamSim是双向的度量衡, 较大的批量包含更多的图像对,
增加一些对子在单步反转后与类似模式汇合的可能性。
相比之下,Vendi分数随着批量大小的增加而增加,因为它估计了被评价的一组中不同样品的有效数量.
因此,这种差异是统计性的,并不表明大批量或小批量产生更多样化的分布。

blocks.en:
We examine the effectiveness of TokenRepel across different repulsion windows,
varying the window from the first 3 steps to the first 24 of the 25 inference steps of FLUX.1-dev.
As shown in the left and middle panels of Figure 10 ,
extending this window consistently improves diversity, but the gains quickly saturate while HPSv3 steadily decreases.
To explain this saturation, we measure the fraction of image tokens whose cross-image similarity exceeds the repulsion threshold at each timestep,
averaged across layers and prompts.
As shown in the right panel of Figure 10 ,
this fraction falls from around 86% at the first step and remains around 10% near the end of sampling.
Early steps shape coarse global structure and contain more similar cross-image patches,
so repulsion affects more tokens.
Later steps refine details, leaving fewer similar tokens to repel.
We therefore apply repulsion only during the first few steps,
capturing most of the diversity gain while reducing the additional computation.

Although our method enhances diversity, the upper bound of achievable diversity is still fundamentally limited by the support of the training data distribution learned by the model. For example, our method is significantly more effective on the FLUX models than on SDXL.
Quality preservation also varies across metrics ( Table 1 ):
it is more pronounced for HPSv3 but less effective for GenEval and PickScore.
In addition, the proposed quality-preserving mechanism is not directly applicable to autoregressive image generative models [ 6 ] ,
since their predictions correspond to probabilities rather than gradient-like score estimates.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We have presented TokenRepel, a test-time approach for enhancing the visual diversity of generated image sets under identical prompts.
First, we outlined a token repulsion mechanism for encouraging patch-wise image diversity by taking a negative Riemannian gradient step on a distribution of features on the unit hypersphere.
Second, we showed how to correct these perturbations so that they remain in the high-density region learned by the generative model and
extend this strategy within the transformer layers.
Our approach demonstrates substantial improvements in diversity of the output images across three T2I models,
while largely preserving the average sample fidelity.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了TokenRepel,这是在相同的提示下加强生成的图像集的视觉多样性的测试时间方法。
首先,我们勾勒出一种象征性的反推机制,通过在单位超层特征分布上采取负面的里曼式梯度步骤,鼓励补丁图像多样性。
第二,我们示范了如何纠正这些扰动,以便它们继续留在高密度地区,从基因模型和遗传模型中吸取教训。
在变压器层内扩展此策略。
我们的方法表明,三个T2I模型的输出图像多样性大有改进,
基本上保持平均样本忠诚

To examine when token density preservation acts,
we measure the cosine similarity between the repulsion displacement 𝐮 m r − 𝐮 m + \mathbf{u}_{m}^{r}-\mathbf{u}_{m}^{+} and the high-density direction 𝐮 m + − 𝐮 m − \mathbf{u}_{m}^{+}-\mathbf{u}_{m}^{-} before correction.
We average over tokens with nonzero repulsion displacement across the layers at the first sampling step of FLUX.2-Klein-9B,
including text tokens in single-stream layers.
As δ \delta increases, the mean cosine becomes more negative and the fraction of negatively aligned tokens rises ( Figure 12 ).
These tokens oppose the estimated high-density direction and would be modified by the half-space correction in Equation 8 .

blocks.en: C.2 Differences from the Camera-Ready Version
blocks.zh: C.2 与相机读取版本的差异

blocks.en:
In this arXiv version, we provide more complete hyperparameter sweeps and a wider diversity–quality trade-off range for each method on GenEval.
We also run all the ablations and analysis experiments on the larger GenEval benchmark (instead of DrawBench) to obtain more convincing results.
Due to our limited computational resources, the setup differs from the camera-ready version as follows: • FLUX.1-dev uses 25 inference steps instead of 35. • All three models generate images at 512 × 512 512\times 512 , whereas the camera-ready version uses 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 for SDXL. • We generate 4 images per prompt instead of 6. • Token density preservation is applied to a different number of layers,
which gives a better trade-off and faster inference. • We parameterize TokenRepel by the angles δ \delta and θ ¯ \bar{\theta} in degrees,
instead of α = tan ⁡ ( δ ) \alpha=\tan(\delta) and β = cos ⁡ ( θ ¯ ) \beta=\cos(\bar{\theta}) ,
since angles directly describe the rotation and the similarity range on the unit hypersphere and are thus easier to interpret. These differences do not change the experimental conclusions.

在这个arXiv版本中,我们为GenEval上的每一种方法提供更完整的超参数扫描和更广泛的多样性-质量权衡范围。
我们还在更大的GenEval基准(而不是Draw Bench)上进行所有模拟和分析实验,以获得更令人信服的结果。
由于我们的计算资源有限,设置不同于相机准备版本如下: • FLUX.1-dev使用25个推断步骤而不是35个. 所有三种模型在512×512 512\times 512时生成图像,而相机准备版本则使用1024×1024 1024\times 1024用于SDXL. ^ 我们每秒生成4个图像,而不是6个。
